tagging: Every test that verifies a criterion names it in its title, e.g. 'SAT-0 AC-1 ...'

acs.text: POST /api/intakes with a client name, a project type (ECOMMERCE, WEBSITE or API) and a description of at least 20 characters returns 201 with a reference like INT-1001 and status RECEIVED
acs.clarified_as: Reference format: 'INT-' then digits (INT-1001 is the first). All three project types accepted.

checks.description: API: POST with each project type and a 46-character description returns 201, reference INT-<digits>, status RECEIVED

acs.text: A description shorter than 20 characters returns 400 with the error "Describe what you want in at least 20 characters"
acs.clarified_as: Under 20 = 19 or fewer characters after trimming; exactly 20 is accepted.

checks.description: API: a 19-character description returns 400 with the exact message; a 20-character one returns 201

acs.text: GET /api/intakes/{reference} returns the submitted intake, and an unknown reference returns 404

checks.description: API: GET by the reference just created returns the same name and type; GET INT-999999 returns 404

acs.text: On the intake page, submitting a valid form shows "Your reference is INT-" followed by the number

checks.description: UI: fill name, type and a valid description, submit, see 'Your reference is INT-<digits>' (API and UI started by Playwright)

acs.text: On the intake page, a description shorter than 20 characters shows the error message and keeps what the client typed
acs.clarified_as: 'Keeps what the client typed' = name, type and description fields still hold the entered values after the error.

checks.description: UI: a short description shows the exact error and the three fields keep their values
